_note: Input table for tools/north-sea-map.js. Edit a status here, then run: node tools/north-sea-map.js
Show project names only. Never write the name of a company in this file, not even in a URL.
group 1: project in a depleted gas field. group 2: pilot or study. group 3: project in a saline aquifer.
points: [lat, lon] pairs from the research file. The marker stands at the mean of the points.
outlines.nsta: exact FIELDNAME values of the NSTA layer. outlines.nlog: FIELD_CODE values of the NLOG layer.
year: the main year of the status (the target start, the start of operation, or the year of the last milestone). null if none.
